transcript_en: Agent: Hello, I am Ananya calling from Atsun Manufacturing. Atsun manufactures thermal paper rolls and barcode labels. Am I speaking with Ravi Nair? User: Sorry, yes, it's me. Agent: Hello Ravi ji. Actually, I am calling from Atsun Manufacturing; we make thermal paper rolls and barcode labels. Would you have just two minutes to talk about your current supply needs? User: Yes, I do. Agent: Thank you, Ravi ji. Well, I wanted to know what is the biggest challenge you face with the thermal paper or barcode labels you are currently using? I mean, is there an issue with quality, cost, delivery delays, or vendor reliability? User: As far as it goes, we face all four of the problems you mentioned. There are issues with the product, quality, and compliance. Besides that, reliability is the biggest issue for us. Agent: Oh, that sounds quite troublesome. Especially reliability issues must cause a lot of interruptions in work. By the way, when these problems occur, how does it affect your billing or dispatch? Are there delays in shipments? User: Yes, as I said. Agent: Yes, I can understand. By the way, when these problems arise, what impact does it have on your work? I mean, is there a delay in billing or any problem with the labeling of shipments? User: Yes sir, it's a huge problem. Billing happens late, and shipments are handled separately. Apart from that, the major problem is that you work for the whole month, but where will you get the money to pay the laborers? The booking hasn't even happened yet. Agent: Oh my, this is indeed a very big problem. I mean, if billing and booking stop, it directly affects payments and labor.  By the way, Ravi ji, where do you currently source these thermal papers and barcode labels from? Do you get them from an existing vendor or through a distributor? User: There is an existing vendor here, Siddharth Innovative. We talk to them, but it's not working out; the supply isn't happening. Agent: I see, so you are getting them from Siddharth Innovative but there are supply issues there. I can understand how much stress increases when the supply is not regular.  By the way, if we talk about a new supplier, what matters most to you? I mean, consistent quality, on-time delivery, pricing, or flexibility in minimum orders? User: All four things, all four things are basic. Agent: That's true, when work is at scale, all four things are very important.  Ravi ji, I wanted to know that if you onboard a new vendor for a trial, who else is involved in this process? I mean, is there any specific process that needs to be followed for approval? User: Sir, which company did you mention? Where are you saying we should get the goods from? Agent: Yes, I am speaking from Atsun Manufacturing. Our company is based in Indore and we manufacture thermal paper rolls and barcode labels ourselves and deliver all over India. User: But their quality isn't strong either. They make third-quality goods. Besides that, they can't even deliver on time. Speaking of consistency, the same type of goods never arrive. They aren't reliable at all. They are all frauds, those bastards. Agent: Oh, that sounds like a very bad experience. I can understand how frustrating it is when both quality and delivery are poor.  Actually, at Atsun Manufacturing, we do production in-house, which is why we have full control over quality and consistency. We also provide pan-India delivery so that there are no gaps in the supply chain.  By the way, Ravi ji, if you onboard a new vendor for a trial, what is the approval process? I mean, who else besides you is involved in this? User: No, no, no, no, I will never buy goods from Atsun in my life; they make such poor quality goods. Does anyone even give such goods? I have seen better goods in my life, even Siddharth's goods are better than theirs. Atsun makes such rubbish goods that I couldn't have even imagined. How can I possibly deal with Atsun? Agent: Ravi ji, I understand your point and I am very sorry that your experience was so bad. I can completely understand your frustration.  If you wish, I can remove your details so that you don't receive any more calls. Should I do that? User: No, no, don't remove the calls. I liked the call vocal. Instead of removing the calls, why don't you improve your quality? Improve your quality before making calls and maintain the dispatch and everything properly. After that, we can plan. What is the point of calling before that? Agent: You are absolutely right, Ravi ji, and I will definitely convey this feedback to my team. There is no point in talking without improvements in quality and dispatch.  I thank you for your honesty. May I keep your contact details in the file for now, so that once we have improved our quality and services, we can contact you again? User: Yes, absolutely. Whenever your quality improves, consistency is balanced, you can do business in a reliable way, and you can ship material punctually, then try calling me. Agent: Absolutely Ravi ji, I understand.
